official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Describe the scene and who it is for: a basket of painted eggs in a spring meadow, white lilies at sunrise, a sunrise over the hills with spring flowers, for Grandma Rosa or the whole family. Add a short line to be spoken in the video if you like, about 15 words, such as Happy Easter to all of you! You get a short video with gentle music and sound, wide or tall for phones and stories.

ChatGPT tells you what the video needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For family chats, stories and an Easter message for the people you love.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds, made from your description, not from your photos, with no words on screen; the music, the sound and the spoken line are generated with the video, so watch it before sharing. It does not post or send the video for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
